column1: # Pinned TriZOD test chains retired by a reviewed decision rather than a rule.
# Read by trizod/dataset/testset.py (load_test_retirements, match_test_retirements);
# the committed pin trizod/dataset/pinned/TriZOD_test_set.fasta is not edited.
# A retired chain is neither test nor training: split test_retired, still a
# leakage target, so its training homologues stay where they are and nothing
# similar to it can enter training later.
# Decision: release re-audit 2026-11-17b, item 9 (check E26), 17 November 2026.
# None of these chains meets the leakage rule (>= 30 % identity over >= 80 % of
# either chain, >= 27 bits) on its deposited sequence, but each is a near-copy of
# training chains once its expression tag or fusion partner is set aside, so its
# labels are largely training labels. Retiring the test chain keeps it a leakage
# target; the alternative, dropping the training partners, cannot clear the GB1
# overlap (17 training GB1 fusions).
# id:        pinned chain ID; the row applies to the pinned chain with this sequence
# sequence:  its pinned sequence (a row whose ID is pinned with another sequence fails)
# reason:    shared_construct (the only reason so far)
# partners:  training chains it nearly copies (comma-separated)
# evidence:  the review, from the re-audit (stage_E e26/v7b/v9)
# Reviewed and KEPT as test chains (no retirement, recorded here as decided):
# - 50148_1_1_1 ~ training 15057_1_1_1 (BET bromodomain): 51.8 % identity over
#   83 % of 15057 (64 % of 50148) once the C-terminal His tag of 15057 is
#   stripped; below the rule on the deposited sequences. Kept.
#   stripping 17306's C-terminal His tag, 50.5 % over 84 % (4224), 46.1 % over
#   90 % (27747) and 38.0 % over 87 % (53200) of 17306; below the rule on the
#   deposited sequences. Kept.
# - Known issue, kept: training 19642_1_1_1 (RBM39 RRM1) is deposited with a
#   57-residue duplicated segment that has no shifts; the duplicate defeats the
#   containment rule against test chain 53299_1_1_1, which is retired below.
#   19642_1_1_1 itself stays a training chain.
# Decision of 17 November 2026 (release validation 2026-11-17c, check E26): ONE

# (trizod/dataset/shared_constructs.py; docs/dataset/dataset-construction.md):

column5: GB1 + N-myc transactivation domain fusion. Without the GB1 tag its N-myc part is 97.6 % identical to training 52066_1_1_1, 53482_1_1_1 and 53483_1_1_1 over 89.4 % of the chain (98 bits); its GB1 part ("KLALNGK" variant) is identical to 17 training GB1 fusions. 92 of its 101 scored residues lie in exact 20-mers shared with training.
GB1 fusion: a 55-residue GB1 run identical to 14 training GB1 fusions (e.g. 16444_1_1_1, 50680_1_1_1, 51093_1_1_1, 6280_1_1_1); 55 of its 92 scored residues lie in exact 20-mers shared with training.

MAGI-1 WW domain (RIKEN GSSGSSG/SGPSSG flanks): 100 % identical to training 6086_1_1_1 (MAGI-1 tandem WW domains) over 85 % of the flank-stripped chain; 40 of its 55 scored residues lie in a 40-residue run identical to 6086.

RBM39 tandem RRM: residues 3-93 (91 aa, 48 % of its scored residues) are identical to training 19642_1_1_1 (RBM39 RRM1), whose deposited sequence carries a 57-residue duplicated segment without shifts that defeats the containment rule.

Prp24 RRM1-2. Residues 79-161 (83 aa) are identical to residues 3-85 of training 16243_1_1_1 (Prp24 RRM2-3, a tolerant training representative, C-terminal His tag stripped) and hold 82 of its 158 scored residues (51.9 %), which meets the E26 criterion (identical run >= 30 residues over >= 50 % of the scored residues). Below the leakage rule (52 % and 45 % coverage); labels agree at 0.35 for 93.7 % of the residues scored in both (MAE 0.067). Release validation 2026-11-17c, E26; decision of 17 November 2026.
